{{Short description|Award in mathematics}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=December 2021}}
The '''Cantor Medal''' of the [[Deutsche Mathematiker-Vereinigung]] is named in honor of [[Georg Cantor]], the first president of the society. It is awarded at most every second year during the yearly meetings of the society.<ref>{{citation |title=Deutsche Mathematiker-Vereinigung (DMV): The German Mathematical Society |first=Thomas |last=Vogt |pages=47–48 |url=http://www.ems-ph.org/journals/newsletter/pdf/2011-12-82.pdf#page=49 |journal=[[Newsletter of the European Mathematical Society]] |volume=82 |date=December 2011 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150306031025/http://www.ems-ph.org/journals/newsletter/pdf/2011-12-82.pdf#page=49 |archivedate=6 March 2015 }}.</ref> The prize winners are [[mathematicians]] who are associated with the German language. The prize money is €4.000.<ref name="k202">{{cite web | title=Preise und Auszeichnungen | website=Deutsche Mathematiker-Vereinigung | url=https://www.mathematik.de/dmv/preise-auszeichnungen | language=de | access-date=25 March 2026}}</ref>

{{div col}}
* 1990 [[Karl Stein (mathematician)|Karl Stein]]<ref name="manin+earlier">{{citation|title=Mathematics People: Manin receives Cantor Medal|url=https://www.ams.org/notices/200301/people.pdf|journal=[[Notices of the American Mathematical Society]]|page=59|date=January 2003|volume=50|issue=1}}.</ref>
* 1992 [[Jürgen Moser]]<ref name="manin+earlier"/><ref name="mactutor">[http://www-history.mcs.st-and.ac.uk/Societies/DMVCantorMedal.html The Georg Cantor Medal of the ''Deutsche Mathematiker-Vereinigung''] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171017201130/http://www-history.mcs.st-and.ac.uk/Societies/DMVCantorMedal.html |date=17 October 2017 }}, [[MacTutor History of Mathematics archive]], retrieved 5 June 2014.</ref>
* 1994 [[Erhard Heinz]]<ref name="manin+earlier"/><ref name="mactutor"/>
* 1996 [[Jacques Tits]]<ref name="manin+earlier"/><ref name="mactutor"/>
* 1999 [[Volker Strassen]]<ref name="manin+earlier"/><ref name="mactutor"/>
* 2002 [[Yuri Manin]]<ref name="manin+earlier"/><ref name="mactutor"/>
* 2004 [[Friedrich Hirzebruch]]<ref name="mactutor"/>
* 2006 [[Hans Föllmer]]<ref name="mactutor"/>
* 2008 [[Hans Grauert]]<ref name="mactutor"/>
* 2010 [[Matthias Kreck]]<ref>{{citation|title=Mathematics People: Kreck receives Cantor Medal|url=https://www.ams.org/notices/201006/rtx100600758p.pdf|journal=[[Notices of the American Mathematical Society]]|page=759|volume=57|issue=6|date=June–July 2010}}.</ref>
* 2012 [[Michael Struwe]]<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20131211121744/http://www.euro-math-soc.eu/node/2938|title=Cantor medal for Michael Struwe, von Kaven-prize for Eva Viehmann}}, [[European Mathematical Society]], retrieved 5 June 2014.</ref>
* 2014 [[Herbert Spohn]]<ref>[http://www.euro-math-soc.eu/node/4513 Cantor medal 2014 to Herbert Spohn] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140606220336/http://www.euro-math-soc.eu/node/4513 |date=6 June 2014 }}, [[European Mathematical Society]], retrieved 5 June 2014.</ref>
* 2017 [[Gerd Faltings]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathematik.de/presse/621-cantor-medaille-der-dmv-fuer-gerd-faltings-ehrenmitgliedschaft-der-dmv-fuer-jean-pierre-bourguignon|title=Cantor-Medaille der DMV für Gerd Faltings Ehrenmitgliedschaft der DMV für Jean-Pierre Bourguignon|website=www.mathematik.de|accessdate=17 December 2021}}</ref>
* 2019 [[Hélène Esnault]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fu-berlin.de/presse/informationen/fup/2018/fup_18_331-cantor-medaille-mathematikerin-esnault/index.html|title=Cantor-Medaille 2019 für Mathematikerin Hélène Esnault|date=22 November 2018|website=www.fu-berlin.de|accessdate=17 December 2021}}</ref>
* 2021 [[Martin Grötschel]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.tu.berlin/nachrichtendetails/martin-groetschel-bekommt-die-cantor-medaille/|title=Martin Grötschel bekommt die Cantor-Medaille|website=www.tu.berlin|accessdate=17 December 2021}}</ref>
* 2024 [[Felix Otto (mathematician)|Felix Otto]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://idw-online.de/de/news835922|title=Cantor-Medaille 2024 für Mathematiker Felix Otto|website=www.idw-online.de|accessdate=25 June 2024}}</ref>
